prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: a single website worn-fit photograph, portrait 4:5, high native detail.
Input image 1 is the authoritative CYMBA earbud product geometry reference, not a composition to copy. Make a new photorealistic editorial close-up of ONE adult person's ear wearing ONE of these compact wired earbuds. Tight frame shows only a natural ear, a little temple with short dark hair, jaw edge and neck. NO full face, eyes, mouth or hands. Natural medium warm skin tone with subtle pores and ordinary soft texture. Neutral grey background and soft directional daylight. Quiet, premium, documentary clarity.
The earbud must be correctly inserted into the lower concha: silicone tip seated inside ear canal and hidden; outward-facing satin dark oval faceplate with THIN champagne rim visible; smoked translucent side housing visible at its edge. The small soft black curved wing follows the inside of the upper concha, stabilizing the bud WITHIN the bowl of the ear, not over the top of the ear. The earbud is truly compact, comparable to an ordinary in-ear monitor, occupying about half the ear height; the whole outer ear remains easy to read around it. Cable exits from the BOTTOM of the shell through a short black strain relief and hangs DOWN beside the neck, never around or behind the top of the ear. No over-ear loop. The inner contact pads, optical window and tip electrodes are concealed against skin because this is an outward worn view; do not paint them on the exterior.
Preserve the product architecture from image 1: a gently oval finely textured satin-black faceplate, slender champagne perimeter, charcoal smoked resin shell, plain soft black concha fin with no metallic contacts on it, thin black braided cable. Do not simplify into a shiny circular disk or create a large hearing aid. Earbud faceplate should sit flush and plausibly within the ear, never hover outside or overlap the outer helix.
Camera at natural ear height, close three-quarter side angle, realistic focus on the earbud and ear, soft falloff beyond. Leave generous framing so the entire ear and downward cable exit are visible; at least 12 percent safe margin around the ear. No labels, logo, text, watermark, graphics, earrings, decorative medical effects or fake glowing skin. One photograph only.
qa: Inspected: one naturally cropped adult ear, compact oval housing within concha, plain wing, downward cable, no full face. Illustrative fit, not a dimensional engineering validation.
